Package com.leap.leaplaughlove.reporting.recap

Class RecapService

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.reporting.recap.RecapService
@Service public class RecapService extends Object
Serves a client's recap of last month: the stored one when the month's job has built it, or one worked out for this request when it hasn't yet, as in the half hour after a month ends. A recap worked out on request has no ranking, since that needs every client's, and isn't stored, so it never stands in for the job's.
